p3_b3.ocr: *, estimated. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0135698.t003 The M1 is unknown but was clearly smaller than the P4 and the distal molars. The metaco- nid is absent on the M2 and M3. The talonid on M2 is simple; only the hypoconulid is clearly visible at the distal part of the talonid. A small anterior keel is visible on the buccal aspect of the paraconid. The M3 differs from the M2 by its larger size and shorter talonid. The talonid of M3 is as simple as the talonid of M2. Description of the postcranial elements. Fibula. The entire fibula is preserved, including both proximal and distal epiphyses. The fibula is partially reconstructed, but this reconstruc- tion does not have any impact on the features described herein. There is no indication that the fibula was fused in any way to the tibia (Fig 11). A tendinal sulcus can be traced on the shaft.
